data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, date picker and Done, Search, sort by Fastest, See flight, Select, Next), but it omits the passengers and filters parameters, gives no concrete values for the second leg, and describes the sort/select step vaguely, so an automation would need guesswork.
